_comment: Facts the switch catalog (sentinel/switches/catalog.py) does not carry, for the website's switch table. 'hardware' is true only when someone ran Heimdall against that physical switch (README 'Supported switches'). website/scripts/gen-switches.py fails on a catalog entry missing here.

hc-swtgw218as.traffic: Per device on a port with exactly one device; a port total on a shared port
hc-swtgw218as.limits: The login cookie is a plain MD5 of the user name and password, sent over HTTP. A device that never transmits is never learned, so a port shared with one is credited to the other device.
